description: What Bullion Trading LLC pays when you sell bullion to us: posted per-item rates (gold, platinum and palladium at spot bid minus 3% for popular items and items we sell, minus 5% for other items; silver at spot bid minus $3 per oz for popular and current items, minus $5 for items we don't usually deal in). Posted rates, not locked quotes. $1,000 minimum per sale. For a whole lot, or items described in words, use estimate_sell. Use when the user asks what Bullion Trading LLC pays to buy an item back. Read-only; posted rates, not a locked quote.
